description.en: Previously opened pages keep their place when you switch between This Computer and Workspace views.
description.zh: 在「此电脑」和工作区的页面之间切换时，已打开的页面会保留原来的位置。

title.zh: 自定义智能体模型不再恢复为 GPT

description.en: Configuring an agent from the Workspace marketplace now saves its endpoint, key, and model for that agent, and This Computer shows the same model. Custom endpoints require a model ID before saving.
description.zh: 从工作区智能体市场配置后，端点、密钥和模型会保存到该智能体；「此电脑」会显示相同的模型。自定义端点需填写模型 ID 才能保存。
